items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I have played second to Rene. ... Rene taken the liking to me, I started playing following his ... Rene sent me on his job

ctx.x: Well who did you, you developed your style along? Anybody influenced you?
Well I imagine Rene did. I imagine the first one. I liked his playing.
Uh huh. And what about, uh, with the mutes? Did you get your mute style from anybody?
